practice.setupHint: Pick the chapters you want. Choose none and questions come from all of them.
practice.couldNotRead: That could not be read. Try something like sqrt(2) or 1/2.

expects.number: A number. You do not need to write x =
expects.set: {count} answers. Give them all, separated by commas - like 2, -5

practice.noContentBody: Try adding another skill or difficulty.

formError.simplified-radical: Right value, but the radical is not fully simplified.
formError.rationalized-denominator: Right value, but there is still a root on the bottom.
formError.scientific-notation: Right value, but not in scientific notation.
formError.factored: Right value, but it is not factorised.
formError.positive-exponents: Right value, but a negative exponent is still there.
formError.vertex-form: Right value, but not in the completed-square form the vertex can be read from.

practice.queueDoneBody: The ones you got right have left the review queue.
practice.incompleteSet: What you gave is right, but this equation has {expected} roots and you gave {found}.
practice.cannotReadYet: Not readable yet - check the brackets.
practice.runLengthNote: Every lesson you picked is asked once before any of them comes round again.
practice.runDoneBody: That is the run. Everything you answered is already in your stats.

accepts.any: Any form with the same value counts.
accepts.factored: Must be factorised - the expanded form does not count.
accepts.simplified-radical: The radical must be simplified; otherwise any form counts.
accepts.rationalized-denominator: The denominator must be free of radicals; otherwise any form counts.
accepts.positive-exponents: No negative exponents; otherwise any form counts.
accepts.vertex-form: Must be in completed-square form - the expanded form does not count.
